notes: SR44 Bed Bath & Beyond (bedbathandbeyond.com, Beyond Inc./Overstock platform). Same access route as Bestsellers/Clearance: homepage/robots.txt direct 200, /c/ paths Akamai 403 direct, translate.goog proxy used to read origin HTML; resultCount + JSON-LD numberOfItems agreed on every fetched page. DISCOVERY: no single site-wide 'New Arrivals' hub URL exists (checked ctaxonomy.xml 1430-URL taxonomy, keyword-search sitemap, related-search sitemap -- no dedicated slug). Instead the mega-menu systematically embeds a 'New Arrivals' entry (tid pattern TN:<Dept>:NewArrivals) under EVERY one of the 10 top-level shopping departments (Furniture, Rugs, Outdoor, Bedding, Bath, Kitchen & Dining, Home Decor, Lighting, Organization/Home Improvement, Baby & Kids) -- unlike Best Sellers this is applied uniformly, which is why it reads as a deliberate site-wide merchandising concept (genuine children of one 'New Arrivals' idea) rather than an arbitrary one-off filter. Mechanically each is the department's top-level category page with a 'promotion=new+products' facet pre-applied (pageType 'Guided Nav: Category Page', same mechanism as ordinary category pages). Treated as parent grouping row (New Arrivals) + 10 department leaves, matching the shared engine's grouping-row convention. No 'New Collection'/'New Season' editorial page found anywhere in nav requiring the ambiguous-collection judgment call. No local-language variants applicable (USA/English site).
